item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "Pisar E Musa E Kazim Raza Mashhad Se Lyrics 2019"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Farman"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Pisar e Musa e Kazim Raza Mashhad Se
Karta Hai Mujh Pe Logo Atta Mashhad Se.

1
Koi Aasi Ho La-Dawa Ho Koi.
Milti Har Ik Ko Hai Shifa Mashhad Se.
Bazu Pe Apne Jo Bandhey Taweez-e-Raza.
Hai Zamin Oss Ka Mazhar-e-Khuda Mashhad Se.

2
Unhi Ke Roze Pe Sar Ko Jhuka Do Apne Tum.
Moaf Ho Gi Tumhari Youn Khata Mashhad Se.
Hoor-o-Gilma Hain Darbar-e-Raza Maula Ke.
Khuld Se Aati Hai Chalti Jo Hawa Mashhad Se.

3
Dikhao Mujh Ko Bhi Jageer Apni Aye Maula.
Karo Manzoor Meri Maula Dua Mashhad Se.
Tumhari Manqabat Yeh Soch Ke Likhe Farman.
Hai Milta Mujh Ko Bhi Iss Ka Sila Mashhad Se.

p = Path('src/data/lyrics/pisar-e-musa-e-kazim-raza-mashhad-se-lyrics-2019-tajpoints-d4a1fb3f533fbc228232.md')
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for version, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in version.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
    assert ''.join(block[0].strip() for block in blocks[1:]) == numbers
assert 'noUrdu' not in yaml and '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified 14 matching verse lines across the opening and three stanzas.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions retain the two-line opening and three numbered stanzas.

Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. I read the ambiguous Roman forms “Zamin” as ضامن and “Gilma” as غلمان.
